fare_rules.concessions: Official provisional fares, notified 4 April 2026: large bus Rs 40 up to 10 km, Rs 70 up to 30 km, Rs 110 above that. Minibus and coach: Rs 50, Rs 80 and Rs 120 for the same distances. The notice says fares remain as they were before 27 February 2026. Route lists for private services are not published officially; help add them.

Put in the bus file for that reason; move to karachi-chinchi if Mnzil's icon turns out to be right.

routes.notes: Zameen Blog (2023-02-23) lists 'D10 Mini Bus Route: Korangi 100 Quarters to Taiser Town' as a current route, with terminals only. The ordered stops are the Zenodo/Habib University chain for label D-10 (CC-BY-4.0; the authors took the routes from the HamariWeb and Travel Culture websites, which are undated, so the age of the stop list is unknown). Both Zenodo D-10 chains are identical, so one was used. Not in the URC 2010 list, RastaYaar or Mnzil. stops_confidence low because the stop list cannot be dated.

open_questions: D-3 bus on Mnzil (Nagan Chowrangi - Indus Hospital) is a different alignment from the 2010 D-3 (Airport - Zia Colony), so the 2010 entry was not promoted.
4-H and D-17 have only terminals or one stop on Mnzil.

No 2023-2026 article with a readable text names G-7, X-5, 4-K, D-1, N-5, U-4, U-6, 2-D, 5-K, 4-J, S-1, Y-11 or A-15 as running. Express Tribune 2026 (story 2609031) remembers W-11, 2D, 5C, 5, 2K, 1C, D7, 4L, Starline, Marwat and Shams coaches as past major routes, but does not say which still run. Tribune and HamariWeb pages return 403 to WebFetch, and the web-search budget ran out.

Route counts: ARY Urdu 2024-01-07 says about 80 routes run (transporters' leader); Arab News 2025-12-03 says about 5,000 buses remain; Express Tribune (story 2389219, probably late 2022) says 16 of 60 bus, 42 of 234 minibus and 20 of 70 coach routes operate. By those counts roughly 60-80 private routes run, close to the 76 bus routes we now hold, but which ones is unconfirmed.

The terminal conflicts between RastaYaar and Mnzil (see karachi-bus-corrections.json) need a third source or a field check. HamariWeb 2024-09-11 backs Mnzil for F-11 (Cattle/Bhains Colony - Mianwali Colony).

The Zenodo routes not yet in karachi-minibus (1-L, 2-C, 7-K, 45-A, 51-C, C-2, C-3, D-4, F-1, F-18, G-55, and coaches such as Agroor, Mahfooz, National, Omar, Safari, Shaheen, Starline) were not re-added here, except D-10, which has a separate 2023 mention. They are a known source in research/incoming/zenodo-karachi-bus-network.
